experiment: G — real BPF-LSM enforcement on CPU
git_commit_note: operator/cmd/lsm-probe, operator/cmd/g1-runner (new tools), operator/Dockerfile.lsm-probe, operator/Dockerfile.g1-runner, ebpf-agent/Dockerfile.gen-bpf (throwaway toolchain image, see exclusions.md), and fixes to ebpf-agent/bpf/agent.bpf.c (LSM verifier rejections) and ebpf-agent/internal/bpfobjs/agent_x86_bpfel.{go,o} (regenerated) are uncommitted working-tree changes at run time, committed together with this experiment directory as the single Task 10 commit immediately after this file is written.
kernel_config_bpf_lsm: y (grep CONFIG_BPF_LSM /boot/config-6.8.0-1064-azure -> CONFIG_BPF_LSM=y, confirmed before any change)
grub_change: Added lsm=lockdown,capability,landlock,yama,apparmor,bpf to GRUB_CMDLINE_LINUX (NOT GRUB_CMDLINE_LINUX_DEFAULT -- this Azure Ubuntu cloud image's /etc/default/grub.d/50-cloudimg-settings.cfg resets GRUB_CMDLINE_LINUX_DEFAULT="" unconditionally on every update-grub, silently discarding anything placed there; GRUB_CMDLINE_LINUX is appended to instead, and survives). Applied via az vm run-command (user-confirmed before executing, since it required a worker-node reboot), followed by `update-grub` and `az vm restart`. Verified post-reboot via /proc/cmdline and /sys/kernel/security/lsm directly (not inferred from CONFIG_BPF_LSM alone, per the protocol's explicit warning).
ebpf_toolchain_note: The pre-committed internal/bpfobjs/agent_x86_bpfel.{go,o} were regenerated for this task, against bpf/headers/vmlinux.h freshly dumped from THIS worker node's own live BTF (bpftool btf dump file /sys/kernel/btf/vmlinux format c, via kubectl debug node), using clang/llvm 14.x specifically (golang:1.25-bookworm base, not the default trixie/clang-19) -- matching the toolchain version recorded in EXPERIMENTS_LOG.md Phase 4 as originally used to build the previously-committed working object. A first regeneration attempt with clang 19 compiled without error but produced verifier-incompatible bytecode for an unrelated, unchanged function (hash_path's loop) -- see exclusions.md.

enforcement_mode_by_node.vm-a2-cpucampaign-20260813-worker: enforce (bpf confirmed in /sys/kernel/security/lsm; agent log: 'determined enforcement mode' mode=enforce)
enforcement_mode_by_node.vm-a2-cpucampaign-20260813-cp: audit (bpf NOT added to this node's LSM list -- intentionally left unmodified as a within-cluster audit-mode control; agent log: mode=audit)

scope_correction: Per the protocol's explicit instruction: this BPF-LSM enforce finding applies ONLY to this new Azure CPU worker node. The historical H100 campaign remains audit/observation-only and this experiment's results are never extended to it.
